none: PAS NLM-EE9593: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Possible Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Youthful bust draped right. Obverse inscription: [--]AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: FEL TEM[P REPARATIO]. Diameter: 19.3mm, Weight: 2.67gms, die axis: 12
